title: Multi-Radar Trajectory Planning Method Based on Imitation Learning
content: To address the high computational complexity and insufficient real-time performance of traditional multi-radar trajectory planning methods in complex electromagnetic interference environments, this paper proposes an imitation learning-based trajectory planning method for multi-radar systems. This method designs a trajectory policy neural network architecture based on multiple semantic information. It proposes a training data construction method with coverage rate as the optimization objective. Then the trajectory policy neural network is trained by using an imitation learning algorithm with an auxiliary target. Simulation results show that the proposed method achieves an average coverage rate of 93.95%, and improves the single-step decision efficiency by a factor of 6.7 compared with heuristic-based trajectory optimization methods.
